overview.en: The giant phantom jelly is a large scyphozoan of the deep open ocean.
overview.fr: La méduse fantôme géante est une grande scyphozoaire de la haute mer profonde.

identification.en: Its bell can exceed one metre across, with four ribbon-like oral arms reaching about ten metres.
identification.fr: Sa cloche peut dépasser un mètre de diamètre et ses quatre bras buccaux rubanés atteindre environ dix mètres.

habitat.en: It has been observed from near the surface to about 6700 metres, across oceans except the Arctic.
habitat.fr: Elle a été observée de la surface jusqu’à environ 6700 mètres, dans les océans sauf l’Arctique.

diet.en: Its likely prey include plankton and small fishes, which its broad oral arms can hold.
diet.fr: Ses proies probables comprennent le plancton et de petits poissons, retenus par ses larges bras buccaux.

behavior.en: It is rarely seen; a 2019 dataset compiled just over a century of sparse observations.
behavior.fr: Elle est rarement observée ; un jeu de données de 2019 rassemble un peu plus d’un siècle de signalements dispersés.

reproduction.en: The consulted field accounts do not describe its reproductive cycle.
reproduction.fr: Les fiches naturalistes consultées ne décrivent pas son cycle reproductif.

ecology.en: A fish has been filmed sheltering among its oral arms, an unusual deep-sea association.
ecology.fr: Un poisson a été filmé à l’abri parmi ses bras buccaux, une association inhabituelle des grands fonds.

conservation.en: The sources describe its rarity of observation but provide no global threat assessment.
conservation.fr: Les sources signalent sa rareté d’observation, mais ne donnent pas d’évaluation mondiale des menaces.

facts: MBARI gives body and arm dimensions, depth and ocean range, likely diet, and observations of a fish associating with the jelly.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.fr: OBIS — Observations in situ de Stygiomedusa gigantea

facts: The research dataset summarizes global records collected over 1899–2009 and depth patterns; it documents observation scarcity, not a conservation rank.

uncertainties: Reproductive biology and population trends remain poorly documented in the sources cited here.
review_note: Used institutional and biodiversity-observation records plus a French-language account of a rare Antarctic sighting; avoided inferring population status from sighting counts.
